name: config-apply-witness
description: Landing site and verification harness for Apply Witness

scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: cargo test --all-targets && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable site/src/main.ts site/src/witness.ts
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run typecheck
